name: Collection Tag Sync
description: Collection Tag Sync keeps direct Movie and Series tags and collection memberships aligned through explicit, safety-conscious mappings.
overview: Synchronize Jellyfin tags and collections through explicit administrator-defined mappings.

versions.changelog: Second alpha with title-first previews, a clearer configuration workflow, compact source-to-target mappings, separated global safety settings, focused collection creation, and locked preservation of explicitly requested names.
Initial alpha release with continuous and Full Reconcile mappings, destructive-change safeguards, run-once operations, GUID-backed collection selection and creation, and an embedded administrator UI.
